topic: the spotlight effect and why nobody's actually watching you at the gym
title: Why No One At The Gym Is Actually Watching You
description: AI-narrated commentary exploring the psychology of the gym 'spotlight effect' -- why we assume everyone's watching us mess up, and why they almost never are. #fitness #psychology #shorts

hook_candidates.text: Almost nobody at the gym is watching you -- even when you drop the weights.
Ever feel like every eye in the gym snaps to you the second you fumble a rep?
The gym isn't judging you nearly as much as you think -- that feeling even has a name.
A psychologist once sent students into a room wearing an embarrassing t-shirt, certain everyone would notice -- almost no one did.

beats.text: Almost nobody at the gym is watching you -- even when you drop the weights.
That's the spotlight effect -- you feel like the main character, but so does everyone else in that room.

beats.text: The judgment you're dreading is mostly imaginary -- comment the excuse that's kept you out longest.
